verdict.rationale: Netlify's git-based deploy pipeline gives PR preview review (netlify-docs-1) and one-click deploy rollback (netlify-docs-5), which indirectly covers versioning/rollback for anything deployed via git, including serverless functions. But there is no dedicated concept of 'automations' as a first-class object with its own audit trail or review workflow distinct from general site/function deploys. Missing for 10: a native automation/workflow builder with its own version history, dedicated review UI for automation changes, and independent evidence of rollback specifically for functions/agents rather than whole-site deploys.
